news_items.headline: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet on his company's monopoly: no one is coming for us
news_items.summary: CEO Fouquet interview ahead of Milken Institute Global Conference frames ASML's EUV monopoly as durable; ASML now most valuable European company at >$530B market cap.

news_items.headline: ASML surges 6.87% as rising AI demand bolsters outlook despite US export risks
news_items.summary: Shares rallied 6.87% versus tech sector +2.36% on AI-driven demand outlook; Big-4 US tech committing >$600B AI infra capex this year sustains lithography demand.

news_items.headline: ASML Holding provides regular update on share buyback program execution
news_items.summary: Active buyback over 4 consecutive trading days, ~12,895-13,383 shares/day, ~EUR 15.87M/day; signals management confidence and provides float reduction tailwind.

news_items.headline: TSMC, ASML & Lockheed: Top Manufacturing News This Week
news_items.summary: Industry roundup positions ASML alongside TSMC as core enablers of global semiconductor manufacturing capacity expansion.

news_items.headline: ASML Holding NV stock moved down by 3.28% on May 4: facts behind the movement
news_items.summary: Single-day -3.28% pullback flagged amid ongoing concerns over China export controls and TSMC's decision to delay High-NA EUV deployment until at least 2029.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Per 11 analysts consensus is Buy; past-3-month average PT $1,791.40, past-month average PT $1,688.72 (range $994.01-$1,971.00). No discrete upgrade/downgrade headlines surfaced in the last 7 days.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 beat: EPS $8.44 (+$0.63 vs estimate), net sales EUR 8.8B, GM 53%; FY26 guidance raised/narrowed to EUR 36-40B backed by SK Hynix and Samsung orders. Street watching Q2 immersion sales pace, modest near-term margin compression, and ongoing China export-control uncertainty.
